thread:
Sam: Thanks for a solid all-hands segment on security/compliance. Sales and Support asked for a single checklist/owner list we can point to. Can we capture owners + short milestones here?

Isha: Will do. Quick overview: assemble SOC2 evidence bundle (initial claims) -> mid-June; BYO KMS (customer-managed keys) design + limited beta -> ~8 weeks; tenant audit-log retention configurable up to 365d behind a feature flag.

Jordan: Infra context: PrivateLink is the preferred zero-egress pattern. We will provide region service names and update terraform modules. VPC peering remains supported but requires extra routing and BGP/NAT work for some customers.

Maggie: For ISO mapping we need access review exports, key policy snapshots, and rotation records. Security/infra please export redacted samples so compliance can build templates.

Kira: Proposed short DRIs and dates for the Confluence page: SOC2 bundle -> Isha + Kira -> 2026-06-15; BYO KMS beta -> Jordan + Sam -> 2026-05-20; Private connectivity guide -> Jordan -> 2026-05-05; Audit-log retention flag -> Kira + Jordan -> 2026-05-12.

Sam: Sounds good. Can we also create a simple public FAQ for BYO KMS limitations for AEs?

Isha: Yes, I'll prepare a FAQ + technical appendix for customers (what we support now, expected beta features, HSM attestation notes). Draft by 2026-04-30.

Jordan: PrivateLink example policy we'll include in the guide (copy-paste):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodPrivateAccess"},
      "Action": "execute-api:Invoke",
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Kira: UX note: default audit-log retention stays 90d. We will expose a tenant-level slider to increase to 365d and add export endpoints. Product needs to wire the UX and APIs.

Security-Bot: Infra scan detected 2 accounts with KMS keys that lack explicit policy statements in the last 24h. Created ticket INFRA-4980.

Maggie: Compliance reminder: SOC2 expects documented rotation cadence and proof of KMS grant reviews. For BYO KMS with external HSMs we need a customer attestation template. Isha, can security draft that?

Isha: Affirmative. Draft checklist + attestation template by 2026-04-28. I'll post the doc here when ready.

Sam: Let's run a weekly 30m drop-in for questions until the SOC2 bundle is finalized. Proposed Tuesdays 9am PT. Jordan, can you schedule and include legal/compliance?

Jordan: I'll create the recurring invite and attach a short agenda template.

DevEx-Bot: New Confluence page created: "Security Evidence + BYO KMS Roadmap" (link withheld). Page owner: Kira.

Sam: Recap actions: SOC2 evidence (Isha+Kira) -> 2026-06-15; BYO KMS beta (Jordan+Sam) -> 2026-05-20; PrivateLink guide (Jordan) -> 2026-05-05; Audit-log retention (Kira+Jordan) -> 2026-05-12; Customer checklist (Isha) -> draft 2026-04-28; Weekly office hours -> Jordan schedule.

Kira: I'll maintain the Confluence page and update statuses weekly. Reply here if you need to reassign items. :thumbsup:
